_description: Cascade Growth 15 — Second cohort for Growth tier validation. Fresh accounts in proptech, biotech, and fintech verticals. Same 15-KPI set as growth_15_saas.json, entirely new narratives with richer Amplitude signals.
_capabilities_unlocked: Feature-level upsell readiness (Module Activation Rate → identifies expansion-ready accounts before CSM conversation)
Workflow friction forensics (Workflow Completion Rate + NPS → pinpoints exact workflow drop-off causing NPS decline)
Disengagement early warning (Login Frequency decline → 45-day leading indicator before DAU drops)
Feature adoption segmentation (Feature Adoption Breadth per persona → which role drives which feature bundle)

_kpi_map.P1-KPI2: Feature Adoption Breadth — which features drive retention (Amplitude)
_kpi_map.P1-KPI6: Workflow Completion Rate — friction point identification (Amplitude)
_kpi_map.P1-KPI7: Module Activation Rate — upsell readiness scoring (Amplitude)
_kpi_map.P3-KPI1: Ticket Resolution Time — Power-of-1: Cost Savings
_kpi_map.P5-KPI3: Expansion Revenue Rate — Power-of-1: Revenue Growth

feature_expansion_signal.question: Which Renova PropTech modules are primed for upsell?
feature_expansion_signal.logic: Module Activation Rate > 80% on core modules + Feature Adoption Breadth expanding → upsell readiness score HIGH

workflow_friction_forensics.question: Why is NPS low at CapitalEdge despite high DAU?
workflow_friction_forensics.logic: Workflow Completion Rate < 60% + Low NPS → specific step-drop identified; friction is structural, not sentiment-based

login_disengagement_warning.question: Is ClearWave Telecom team quietly disengaging?
login_disengagement_warning.logic: Login Frequency declining 3 weeks before DAU drops → 45-day early warning window for proactive CSM intervention

accounts.name: Renova PropTech
accounts.narrative: PropTech Series B managing commercial real estate portfolios. Module Activation Rate 87% across core + advanced modules. Feature Adoption Breadth 6.2 — asset managers, leasing, compliance, and facilities all active. Golden Path Velocity 82%. Expansion into new regional office being planned by CTO.

key_signals.content: Module Activation Rate hit 87% — 6 feature bundles active across 4 team personas
CTO requesting platform deployment for new Pacific Northwest regional office — 80 new seats

accounts.name: Keystone BioResearch
accounts.narrative: Life sciences CRO. Golden Path Velocity 72%, Feature Adoption Breadth 5.1 — scientists, clinical leads, data managers, and regulatory all engaged. Login Frequency stable at 4.8x/week. NRR 116%. CSO proactively expanding to companion diagnostics team.

key_signals.content: CSO confirmed multi-year renewal and expansion to companion diagnostics — 3 new departments

accounts.name: CapitalEdge FinOps
accounts.narrative: Investment portfolio SaaS. Workflow Completion Rate only 57% despite high DAU — the Amplitude data tells the story: users start the risk analysis workflow but abandon at step 4. NPS at 34. Golden Path Velocity 48%. Friction is structural; Amplitude pinpoints the exact drop-off step.

key_signals.content: NPS dropped from 43 to 34 — Amplitude shows 43% of users abandoning risk workflow at step 4
Quant engineer filed 18 workflow UX improvement tickets — workflow_completion_rate confirmed at 57%

accounts.name: ClearWave Telecom
accounts.narrative: Telecom SaaS. Network operations champion departed Mar 1. Login Frequency dropped first — Amplitude caught it 47 days before DAU fell (exactly the 45-day early warning window). Persona Breadth now 1.3, Feature Adoption Breadth collapsed. Exec sponsor hasn't engaged in 7 weeks.

key_signals.content: Amplitude detected Login Frequency decline — 47 days before DAU drop (early warning window)
VP Network Ops Darius Webb departed — was platform champion and only power user driving 5 modules
Feature Adoption Breadth collapsed from 5.8 to 1.2 — only basic monitoring module active
New ops manager evaluating Nokia NSP for network analytics

actions.action: Natalie Ortiz identified via stakeholder mapping — emergency re-onboarding scheduled
actions.outcome: 2 new team members activating on core network monitoring module

actions.action: VP CS direct call to CTO — Amplitude ROI data shared
actions.outcome: CTO agreed to 45-day evaluation before competitor decision

accounts.name: Ardent Logistics Tech
accounts.narrative: Freight and warehouse SaaS. Kubernetes migration broke 3 core workflows — Workflow Completion Rate dropped from 78% to 31%. Login Frequency fell 60% as users gave up. Golden Path Velocity at 18%. Escalation rate 18%. NPS 14. Despite high Persona Breadth (3.4) the org still wants the tool — they just can't use it.

key_signals.content: Kubernetes migration broke 3 workflows — Workflow Completion Rate fell from 78% to 31%, Login Frequency down 60%
SVP Supply Chain Technology escalated formally — SLA breach documentation filed
NPS dropped from 47 to 14 — warehouse and freight teams both in detractor territory

actions.action: Engineering SWAT — Kubernetes rollback on 2 of 3 broken workflows
actions.outcome: Workflow Completion Rate recovering to 52%; Login Frequency up 40% from trough

actions.action: Weekly SVP review + Amplitude workflow analytics shared
actions.outcome: Escalation rate dropping from 18% to 10%; 3rd workflow fix targeted for mid-March

accounts.name: Vantage AgriTech
accounts.narrative: Precision agriculture SaaS. Perfect storm: exec sponsor left (acquired by private equity), golden path at 8%, login frequency near-zero, module activation rate 0.9 (only 1 of 7 modules active). NPS 1, escalation 26%. GRR 61%. The Amplitude data shows exactly when engagement started unraveling — 5 months ago. Renewal in 30 days.

key_signals.content: VP Digital Agriculture left post PE acquisition — was exec sponsor and platform architect
Amplitude: Login Frequency hit zero for 80% of users within 3 weeks of sponsor departure
Module Activation Rate collapsed from 6.8 to 0.9 — only basic field reporting module used
PE-appointed CFO flagged all SaaS contracts for elimination — cost reduction mandate
PE operations team evaluating John Deere's built-in digital platform as replacement

actions.action: CEO-to-CFO meeting — Amplitude ROI model showing $6.7M in yield optimization value
actions.outcome: CFO granted 90-day extension; agreed to evaluate against John Deere platform

actions.action: Rapid re-onboarding — 6 field managers trained; 4 modules reactivated
actions.outcome: Module Activation Rate recovering to 3.1; Login Frequency up for 60% of users

actions.action: Yield analytics comparison report — 23% better accuracy vs John Deere baseline
actions.outcome: CFO softened stance — PE board review scheduled for Q2 renewal decision
